_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Hues i Sèrpiente na un {width}×{height} grid.
Bo kontrola sèrpiente {player_id}. Muevenan válido: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (òf w/s/a/d).
Objetivo: sobreviví mas largo òf ta e mas largo i obtene e puntaje mas haltu (limite di turno {max_turns} turnonan).

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} a muri pa motibu di un move invalido.

outcome.survived_win: E hungadó {player_id} a sobrebibí; tur otro persona a pèrdè nan bida.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Tur e serpentenan a muri simultáneamente.
outcome.outlived: E hungadó a sobreviví na tur otro.
outcome.turn_limit: E limite di turno a yega - e mihó skor ta gana den tie-break.
